dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do I still need weapons if I've got Prime Ice?

dialogues.speaker: Kuzmichev
dialogues.text: Well, that's not the first time I've heard that. The last guy debated me a good long time, too — until I picked up a shovel and patted him lightly on the cheek.

dialogues.speaker: Kuzmichev
dialogues.text: Hah. You should've seen him. So freaked out he could barely summon up an inch of Prime Ice! That shut him up — sent him packing in silence, too.

dialogues.speaker: Kuzmichev
dialogues.text: ...All that to say, dear customer, that there's nothing like having steel in your hand, ready to leap to your defense!
